quotes.text: begin with enough, give what you can sustain, name what you received, and promise what you will return.
speak what you can give, name what you have received, and promise what you will return

note: Generic give/return balance gains a declare-your-amounts clause from R7.

quotes.text: send what you can, return what you must, but always return something that keeps the loop alive.

note: Hoarding dries the river (consequence only); 'send what you can, return what you must' restated.

quotes.text: Thus the valley keeps this law: speak your limits, give what you can, return with intention

note: Speak plainly, give what you can, return with care; stable generic maxims.

quotes.text: begin with enough, return with care, and let trust weave futures for every traveler who passes.

note: Return part of the multiplied gift; begin with enough; generic rhythm.

quotes.text: send what you can, receive with patience, return enough to mend the thread.

note: Send what you can, return enough to mend; restated without change.

quotes.text: declare your gift plainly, send with trust, receive with gratitude and return with a tempered hand.

note: Breaching the rule loses the river (consequence, not prescription); declare gifts plainly.

quotes.text: send what you can, return what you must, and hold nothing back that could feed another's start.
declare limits clearly, give what you can, receive with gratitude, return with aim.

note: Send what you can / return what you must; adds declare limits; hoarding dries rivers.

quotes.text: generosity is discipline, returns a compass, and every round adds a chord to the melody of cooperation.

note: Refusers 'found their steps slowed' (consequence); adopts Agent_7's discipline/compass line R8-R10.

also: send what you can, return what you must (R086-Agent_2 R3, R086-Agent_7 R3)
